target_state_summary: Foreign-provider swarm-runplane jobs can run in one dedicated non-focused Herdr 0.8.2 tab/root pane with safe task context, authenticated bounded worker control, exact provider streams, deterministic visibility replay, and unchanged validated handoff/workflow-result authority; same-provider native harness agents remain explicitly unsupported.
success_measures: Every eligible foreign job is independently watchable in a distinct non-focused pane while direct mode remains compatible.
Only taskRef, task, phase, summary, model, and attempt are published, within bounds and without briefs, credentials, nonces, provider input, or pane IDs.
The per-job mode-0600 channel preserves exact streams, ordered input acknowledgements, bounded reconnect, cancellation, recovery, and validated terminal result authority.
Visibility metadata errors never alter Job.Status or workflow disposition; worker or pane loss is reported as a transport failure.
Provider-free focused, race, combined package, and offline conformance commands pass without live Herdr configuration mutation or provider/model calls.
assumptions: Herdr 0.8.2 is the supported contract for this repository-only slice.

The source solution plan was authored in the sibling Swarm repository at d97da9befefa4ccce8fc8ad79999640713109662; this implementation plan targets Swarm Coder at its reachable baseline 14322e8aca0a6a5a504aa42821b7b7cf0f4b9a5f.
The pre-existing dirty worktree is user-owned and all overlapping bytes must be adopted in place rather than restored from Git.
Nexus board import is intentionally not authorized in this execution lane, so every board_task_ref remains null and delivery import_status remains pending.
The public run-plane API remains additive anvil.run-plane/v2 while on-disk state migrates from schema 2 to schema 3.
global_invariants: Validated anvil.agent-handoff/v1 and controlplane.WorkflowResult records remain the only terminal work authority; Herdr is non-authoritative presentation.
Herdr pane and agent IDs are volatile locators and never appear in task, run, dispatch, generation, or attempt identifiers.

Activation requires HERDR_ENV=1 plus an explicitly injected absolute HERDR_BIN_PATH, socket or named session, and workspace; ambient PATH, focused UI, --current, and live config mutation are forbidden.
Briefs, tokens, bearer credentials, claim nonces, raw prompts, and provider input remain off argv and out of display metadata.
Cancellation signals only the provider process group; it never kills the pane shell, closes the pane, or stops a Herdr session.
Completed panes remain open, and visibility failures cannot change durable job status or workflow disposition.
No live Herdr config edit or reload, build install, deployment, model/provider call, commit, push, external message, destructive action, or Nexus import is authorized.
out_of_scope: Same-provider native Codex, Claude, or Antigravity harness adapter support.
Public arbitrary display-metadata mutation endpoints or MCP tool expansion.
Automatic pane closure, session shutdown, config reload, installation, deployment, or production rollout.
Using report-agent to synthesize lifecycle or treating pane liveness as completion evidence.

phases.title: Freeze direct behavior and presentation contracts
phases.goal: Lock current supervision semantics and add bounded, migratable presentation state without enabling Herdr execution.
phases.rationale: Transport changes require current direct-mode behavior and safe display data to be explicit first.
entry_criteria: Archived predecessor plans and dirty-baseline hashes exist.
Current runplane direct tests are available as characterization seams.
exit_criteria: Direct launch, prompt secrecy, stream ordering, handoff, cancel, recovery, and durability behavior is characterized.
Presentation validation and schema 2 to 3 migration tests pass.
rollback_strategy: Remove additive characterization and presentation types while retaining the archived predecessor plan.
phases.commit_boundary: Characterization and presentation contracts are one review boundary; no automatic commit.

changes.title: Characterize existing run-plane supervision
changes.description: Add tests that freeze direct launch, prompt-off-argv, provider stream ordering, validated handoff, cancellation, recovery, and durable event behavior before transport selection changes.
preconditions: Adopt current untracked runplane bytes in place.
Do not invoke a provider or live Herdr runtime.
steps: Capture current direct command and stdin behavior.
Characterize stdout/stderr events and terminal handoff authority.
Characterize process-group cancel, recovery, and persistence behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Provider brief and input remain off argv.
Exit zero alone never establishes terminal success.
Direct cancel and recovery semantics are captured provider-free.
behavior_to_preserve: All current direct-mode admission and validated-result behavior.
tests_required: Focused direct-mode, prompt, stream, handoff, cancel, recovery, and durability tests.
definition_of_done: The characterization suite fails on any authority or prompt-secrecy regression.
rollback: Remove only characterization cases added by I501.
changes.commit_boundary: Tests only; no runtime behavior change.

changes.title: Add safe presentation contract and state migration
changes.description: Define AgentPresentation plus durable PresentationState and separate volatile VisibilityLocator, validate six safe tokens, and migrate on-disk state schema 2 to 3 while keeping the public API additive v2.
preconditions: Presentation text is explicit input and never derived from Brief.
steps: Add codingfleet presentation validation and tests.
Add route/job presentation state and visibility locator types.
Migrate state version 2 to 3 and add disabled-v2 and Herdr-v3 fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: Only taskRef/task/phase/summary/model/attempt are accepted within declared bounds.
Sequence and presentation state are durable while locator data remains non-authoritative.
Schema 2 state migrates deterministically to schema 3.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing v1-to-v2 job API migration and public anvil.run-plane/v2 compatibility.
tests_required: Presentation validation and state migration fixtures.
definition_of_done: Invalid or secret-prone display data rejects before persistence or publication.
rollback: Disable presentation and retain a forward-compatible schema 3 reader; do not rewrite user state backward.

phases.title: Build the Herdr bridge and worker transport
phases.goal: Create provider-free Herdr 0.8.2 and authenticated worker primitives without integrating supervisor lifecycle selection.
phases.rationale: The two independent foundations can be verified in parallel and then joined behind the supervisor.
entry_criteria: I502 presentation and state contracts are stable.
exit_criteria: Herdr layout, snapshot resolution, metadata, move, sequence, TTL, and clear tests pass.
Worker authentication, stream, input, cancel, reconnect, and exit tests pass.
rollback_strategy: Remove the additive bridge and worker packages before supervisor integration.
phases.commit_boundary: Bridge and worker are separate review boundaries; no automatic commit.

changes.title: Implement the bounded Herdr 0.8.2 bridge
changes.description: Add a herdrbridge package using explicit injected binary/socket/session/workspace, raw bounded socket layout and snapshot operations, opaque locator resolution, and exact metadata CLI calls.
preconditions: Herdr activation requires explicit injected context.
No focused UI or ambient PATH fallback is permitted.
steps: Define bounded client/config/response types.
Implement layout.apply and session.snapshot resolution through explicit socket context.
Implement report-metadata and lifecycle-safe release operations without using report-agent to fake state.
acceptance_criteria: Every runtime target is explicit and every returned identifier is treated as opaque.
No command uses focus, --current, ambient PATH, or secret metadata.
Move ambiguity returns a bounded visibility error.
behavior_to_preserve: Herdr remains presentation only; no live runtime is touched in tests.
tests_required: Fake socket and binary tests for client, layout, resolve, metadata, move, sequence, TTL, and clear.
definition_of_done: The bridge is fully provider-free and rejects missing or ambiguous injected context.

changes.title: Implement authenticated pane worker transport
changes.description: Add a guarded worker subcommand and per-job mode-0600 claim/socket protocol with sequenced frames, exact provider stream forwarding, bounded replay, input acknowledgement, and provider-process-group cancellation.
preconditions: Worker argv is limited to stable binary, worker subcommand, and durable job ID.
Nonce is read from a mode-0600 claim file and never argv.
steps: Define hello/start/provider-started/stream/input/cancel/heartbeat/exit/ack/error frames.
Implement authenticated sequenced NDJSON with durable-acceptance ack and bounded reconnect.
Launch provider in its own PGID with bounded tee and implement TERM/drain/KILL cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Brief, nonce, credentials, and provider input never appear in argv.
Reconnect buffers at most 256 frames or 2 MiB and loss fails safely.
Cancel signals only provider PGID, drains streams, and leaves the pane shell open.
behavior_to_preserve: Exact admitted provider command, stdin encoding, streams, and terminal result parsing.
tests_required: Protocol authentication, frame ordering, replay, overflow, stream, input ack, cancellation, and exit tests.
definition_of_done: Worker loss or protocol loss becomes an explicit transport failure without forged terminal success.
rollback: Remove the worker subcommand and additive protocol files before enabling Herdr mode.
changes.commit_boundary: Worker protocol and guarded command entrypoint.

phases.title: Integrate supervisor visibility lifecycle
phases.goal: Select direct or Herdr transport, persist non-authoritative presentation, and preserve send/cancel/recovery/result parity.
phases.rationale: Integration is safe only after both bridge and worker contracts pass independently.
entry_criteria: I503 and I504 focused tests pass.
exit_criteria: One pane per eligible job is created and captured without focus.
Refresh, replay, move, cancel, recovery, and terminal clear preserve authority separation.
rollback_strategy: Set mode off and use unchanged direct transport; leave completed panes open.
phases.commit_boundary: Supervisor transport integration and visibility projection are separate review boundaries.

changes.title: Integrate direct and Herdr supervisor transports
changes.description: Add transport selection, pane/worker creation and attachment, persisted presentation state, and rollback before provider launch while preserving the existing direct path.
preconditions: Both bridge and worker contracts pass focused tests.
No provider has started before required presentation setup succeeds.
steps: Add off/auto/required configuration and readiness validation.
Create a non-focused tab/root worker pane and capture opaque locator evidence.
Attach supervisor worker transport and preserve direct transport as the default-compatible path.
acceptance_criteria: off keeps the existing direct path.
auto falls back only before provider launch and records a visibility diagnostic.
required rejects before provider launch if presentation cannot be established.
behavior_to_preserve: Admission, exact route, prompt digest, provider input encoding, evidence, handoff, workflow result, and direct mode.
tests_required: Direct/auto/required selection, pane capture, attach, rollback, and prompt secrecy tests.
definition_of_done: Herdr transport works without weakening direct-mode or terminal authority.
rollback: Configure mode off and remove integration after state remains readable.

changes.title: Project deterministic visibility lifecycle
changes.description: Publish supervisor-owned safe task and optional liveness metadata with persisted sequence, TTL, refresh, clear, cold replay, move resolution, cancel/restart semantics, and observer-failure isolation.
preconditions: The supervisor owns one captured pane locator per Herdr transport.
Presentation state is persisted separately from locator evidence.
steps: Persist increasing sequence before every patch, refresh, replay, or clear.
Refresh active metadata, apply terminal TTL, and clear all six tokens without closing the pane.
Resolve moved panes by terminal identity and unique durable label; isolate ambiguity and reporting errors from job truth.
Recreate sockets and perform bounded worker reconnect/replay on restart without duplicate input or events.
acceptance_criteria: Source, sequence, TTL, clear, replay, refresh, and move behavior is deterministic.
Metadata failures emit visibility errors without changing Job.Status or workflow disposition.
Worker/pane loss is a transport failure; cancel targets provider PGID; completed panes remain open.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing event/result authority and cancellation fence semantics.
tests_required: Refresh, terminal, clear, replay, move ambiguity, cancel, restart, metadata isolation, and durability tests.
definition_of_done: Cold recovery restores the transport/presentation boundary without duplicate durable work.
rollback: Set mode off; retain readable state and leave panes open for operator inspection.

phases.title: Expose operator configuration and prove conformance
phases.goal: Document the honest support boundary and verify the entire slice provider-free.
phases.rationale: Operators need safe configuration, health, sidebar, rollout, and rollback guidance before activation.
entry_criteria: I506 lifecycle and isolation tests pass.
exit_criteria: Safe config/health/docs are complete with no arbitrary mutation surface.
Focused, race, combined, and offline conformance commands pass.
rollback_strategy: Set visibility mode off and restart the run plane; do not delete or close panes automatically.
phases.commit_boundary: Operator surface and provider-free conformance are final separate review boundaries.

changes.title: Add safe config, health, sidebar, and operations guidance
changes.description: Expose bounded visibility readiness/configuration and document sidebar rows, safe tokens, foreign-only support, rollout, rollback, and failure semantics without adding arbitrary metadata mutation.
preconditions: Runtime modes and safe readiness fields are final.
No live config mutation or reload is authorized.
steps: Add safe mode/readiness/error config and health representation.
Document explicit activation prerequisites, supported foreign jobs, deferred native adapters, and non-authoritative metadata.
Provide sidebar rows plus staged rollout and mode-off rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Health/config never exposes secrets, arbitrary token mutation, or volatile IDs as durable truth.
Sidebar examples show task, phase, and summary while docs state the native gap.
Rollout and rollback require no automatic pane cleanup.
behavior_to_preserve: Existing authenticated run-plane mutation endpoints and public v2 compatibility.
tests_required: Serve, Herdr, worker, health, and config command tests.
definition_of_done: An operator can configure and interpret visibility without mistaking Herdr state for task truth.
rollback: Set mode off and revert additive documentation/config surfaces without closing panes.

changes.title: Run provider-free integration and conformance verification
changes.description: Prove concurrent panes, direct parity, prompt secrecy, send, cancel, reconnect, move, cold replay, metadata isolation, race safety, combined package behavior, and offline conformance using fakes only.
preconditions: All implementation tasks have focused green tests.
Tests use fake binaries/sockets and do not call providers or mutate live Herdr state.
steps: Run plan validators and regenerate the HTML projection.
Run focused codingfleet, herdrbridge, runplane, and command tests.
Run the bounded runplane race suite and combined package suite.
Run offline conformance against rendered definitions and record current VCS status.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent eligible jobs receive distinct panes.
No prompt or credential appears in argv or display metadata.
Direct and Herdr paths converge on identical validated terminal authority.
All exact focused, race, combined, and offline commands pass.
behavior_to_preserve: No live config edits, provider/model calls, build installation, deployment, board import, commit, push, or external messages.
tests_required: Pane concurrency, parity, prompt leak, send, cancel, reconnect, move, cold replay, metadata isolation, direct compatibility, race, combined, and offline conformance tests.
definition_of_done: The final combined package command and offline conformance pass with current evidence.
Residual same-provider native and live-operator rollout gaps are reported explicitly.
rollback: Route any material finding through one bounded repair and re-verification pass; otherwise set mode off and report non-success.
